calibration.axes: x right, y down, z forward
calibration.basis: Publisher recommends ROS default intrinsics without undistortion for pre-registered PNG depth. Depth is already rescaled and expressed in RGB optical coordinates; apply no extra correction or IR-to-RGB transform. This is the recommended approximation, not newly measured calibration.

generation: Every indexed depth frame; CPU point-to-point ICP from current into previous camera, identity pair initialization, world_from_current = world_from_previous @ previous_from_current. First successfully decoded frame is the sole identity anchor. On tracking failure retain errors for every subsequent frame without resetting or reference relocalization. RGB is indexed but not used for fitting. No groundtruth is extracted or interpreted until estimates are frozen.
scope: A fixed complete-sequence protocol awaiting official data acquisition. No real trajectory accuracy, measured clock synchronization, loop closure, RGB photometric odometry or broad sensor calibration is established by fixture tests.
